title: doola MCP Is Now Live in Claude: Form Your US LLC in Chat
summary: doola MCP is now live in Claude. Form your US LLC in the same conversation where you plan your business. No US address or SSN needed.
body_markdown:
You might be using Claude to build your business, from validating ideas and pricing to drafting your landing page. Instead of jumping to an external site and retyping your information, you can now form your company right where you plan it.


With doola MCP live in Claude, you can[form your US LLC directly inside your chat](https://www.doola.com/formation-api/) thread.


Simply connect doola once and prompt:


> *“Help me form an LLC with doola.”*


Claude guides you through a few quick questions, and doola files your LLC directly with the state.


Claude was among the very first platforms to feature doola MCP. Today, it is also available on ChatGPT, Replit, Lovable, Perplexity, and Vercel.


## What Is doola MCP?


Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridges the gap between AI chat and real-world execution.


- **Without MCP:** Claude can only tell you ***how*** to form an LLC.


- **With doola MCP:** Claude actually ***forms*** it for you.


By adding the doola connector to Claude once, you can handle your entire US LLC filing inside your normal chat window, no extra steps, external forms, or tab switching required.


## The Tab-Switching Tax is Over: Form Your LLC Right Where You Built the Plan


If you use Claude to write your pitch deck, draft contracts, or code your MVP, you know how annoying it is to stop everything just to set up your business.


Going from a working draft in Claude to a legal company used to mean opening a separate incorporation site, creating an account, and manually copy-pasting your business name, founder details, and addresses line by line.


With doola MCP, you skip the forms entirely. Here is how it works:


1. **Trigger the filing:** In the same chat where you just mapped out your product or deck, tell Claude: *“Help me form an LLC with doola.”*
2. **Review & Pay:** Claude uses the context already in your chat to pre-fill your information, prompts you for anything missing (like owner percentages or mailing address), and generates a simple payment link.
3. **doola files with the state:** Once payment is done, doola handles the state paperwork in the background while you keep working.


You stay in your workflow, and you don’t type the same information twice.


## Why Claude?


Founders actively rely on Claude to map out early ideas, build strategies, and reach key business decisions:


> Claude is where the business gets thought through.


- Research market dynamics and direct competitors


- Model first-year revenue projections and financial plans


- Draft terms of service and essential operational agreements


- Outline equity splits and founder roles


By the time you are ready to officially incorporate, Claude already holds the critical context, what the business does, target demographics, owner details, and physical location.


### The Workflow Broke at Incorporation


Until recently, taking the leap from planning to incorporation meant hitting a wall:


- Decisions stayed trapped inside the chat window


- Founders had to abandon their AI context and re-enter everything into a separate formation platform


- Paperwork delays frequently turned a quick filing step into weeks of lost momentum


The **doola Model Context Protocol (MCP)** bridges this divide directly inside your workspace:


-


Eliminates manual data re-entry on external websites
-


Uses the business context and details already shared in your chat session
-


Formally incorporates your company directly within the same Claude conversation where you built it


## What doola MCP Can Do Inside Claude


Here’s each thing the doola connector does, in the order you’ll see it.


- **Sign you in.** You connect your existing doola account, or create a new one, when you first add the connector.


- **Answer your formation questions.** You can ask Claude things like which state to choose. Claude explains your options in plain language before you decide.


- **Collect your company details.** Claude asks for your company name, where you live and your formation state.


- **Send you to checkout.** Claude will link to a new tab and the user will check out in that new tab and then come back and confirm the payment is complete.


- **Collect the filing details after payment.** Claude then asks for the rest of what’s needed to file, such as your addresses, members and ownership split.


- **Submit your LLC for filing.** Once everything is collected, your LLC is submitted to the state. doola handles the filing and your registered agent.


- **Hand you off to your doola dashboard.** After that, you continue in your doola dashboard. That’s where you can track your filing and handle your EIN and banking.


Your EIN and bank account are handled in your doola dashboard after formation, not in the chat itself.


## What the Experience Looks Like


The formation conversation breaks down into two straightforward phases:


### Phase 1: Before Payment


Claude asks for the core details needed to quote and configure your setup:


- Your primary residence / current location


- Your desired company name


- Your preferred formation state *( **Note:** doola MCP currently processes filings in Wyoming)*


- Your selected doola package


You can respond in plain, natural language. If you have questions about state differences or structure, you can ask Claude to walk you through the options in real time.


### Phase 2: After Payment


Once payment is complete, you return to the same conversation thread.


Claude then collects the remaining filing requirements:


- A brief description of your business activity


- Alternative company names (in case your first pick is unavailable with the state)


- Your official business address and mailing address


- LLC members and their respective ownership percentages


- Your designated IRS Responsible Party (the individual who controls or manages the entity and its finances, as defined by the IRS)


**No redundant data entry required:** Claude carries over all context previously shared in the chat, so you never have to retype information you’ve already discussed.


“Founders already use Claude to think through the business: the idea, the pricing, the first customers. Forming the company should happen in that same conversation, not in a separate tab three days later. With doola MCP inside Claude, the plan and the company come together.”


Arjun Mahadevan, Founder and CEO, doola


## Step-by-Step: How to Connect doola MCP in Claude


Setting up the doola connector takes about five minutes, and you only have to do it once.


Here is how to link doola to Claude so you can form your LLC inside your chats:


1. Open Claude.
2. Navigate to **Settings → Connectors** .
3. Click **Add Custom Connector** .
4. Enter:


- **Name:** doola
- **MCP Server URL:** https://mcp.doola.com
- Click **Add Connector** .


5. Sign in to your existing doola account or create a new doola account.
6. Complete the OAuth authorization flow.
7. Start a new conversation.
8. doola MCP is now available in Claude.


**Note:** Custom MCP connectors are available on supported Claude plans and workspaces.


### Which Claude Plans Support This?


Custom connectors are available on Claude’s Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, according to[Anthropic’s help center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp) .


- **Free plan:** You can add one custom connector.


- **Pro and Max plans:** You add the connector yourself.


- **Team and Enterprise plans:** An Owner of your organization has to add the doola connector first. After that, members can use it.


## Launching a US LLC as a Non-US Resident


You do not need to live in the US, hold a US address, or visit the country to form your company[using doola MCP in Claude](https://www.doola.com/formation-api/) .


#### What Non-US Founders Need to Know:


- **Global Access:** doola supports non-US founders across **175+ countries** and has helped over **25,000+ businesses** form in the US.


- **No SSN Required:** You do not need a Social Security Number (SSN) or a US residential address to initiate the filing.


- **Banking Setup Included:** Once your LLC is filed and approved, eligible non-US founders can get direct support opening a US business bank account through doola.


After your LLC is formed, eligible founders without an SSN can get help opening a US business bank account through doola.

### Beyond Chat: Embedded Formations


Some of the platforms you might already use to run your business can also form your company.


[Ramp](https://www.doola.com/blog/doola-powers-incorporation-inside-ramp-for-agents/) ,[Whop](https://www.doola.com/blog/doola-powers-llc-formation-inside-whop/) ,[Naïve](https://www.doola.com/blog/doola-powers-company-formation-inside-naive/) , **[HelloGov](https://www.doola.com/blog/doola-powers-business-formation-inside-hellogov/)** , and **[Incorpify](https://www.doola.com/blog/doola-powers-company-formation-inside-incorpify/)** have built the[doola Formation API](https://www.doola.com/formation-api/) into their web apps, so you can start your LLC from the same dashboard where you manage spending, payments, or paperwork.


The partner app collects your details, and the filing itself runs through doola.


The same doola team that handles direct orders prepares your official documents and submits them to the state, so the process and the standard of care stay the same no matter where you start.


## What Happens After Your LLC Is Formed


Forming your LLC is just step one. Keeping your business compliant and running smoothly takes ongoing back-office work, which doola handles depending on the[doola pricing plan](https://www.doola.com/pricing/) you choose:


- **Registered Agent Service:** Included in **all plans** . doola serves as your official state contact to maintain compliance.


- **Employer Identification Number (EIN):** Included in **all plans** . doola files with the IRS to obtain your company tax ID.


- **US Business Banking:** Included in **all plans** for eligible non-US and US founders to open a US bank account.


- **State Compliance & Annual Reports:** Included in **Tax & Compliance** and **Business-in-a-Box™** . doola tracks and files your annual state reports to keep your company in good standing.


- **Business Taxes:** Included in **Tax & Compliance** and **Business-in-a-Box™** . doola’s CPA team handles your state and IRS tax filings.


- **Bookkeeping:** Included in **Business-in-a-Box™** (or available as an add-on). doola manages your continuous bookkeeping and monthly reconciliations.

## FAQs


#### How does doola MCP work with Claude?


You add doola as a custom connector in Claude settings, sign in with your doola account and start a new conversation. Claude then guides you through LLC formation in plain language.


doola handles the state filing, registered agent and backend processing. Setup takes about five minutes.


#### Can I actually form a real US LLC inside Claude?


Yes. Your LLC is legally filed with the state. It is not a draft or a placeholder. You can track filing progress in real time on your doola dashboard.


#### Which Claude plan do I need?


Custom MCP connectors are available on supported Claude plans and workspaces. Formation fees are charged separately by doola.


#### Does it work if I am not based in the US?


Yes. doola has helped founders from 175+ countries form US LLCs, including founders without a US SSN or US mailing address. You never need to visit the US.


#### How long does LLC formation take through doola?


Wyoming and Delaware typically process in 1 to 3 business days. EIN procurement from the IRS takes another 1 to 5 business days after the LLC is approved.


#### What does doola handle after formation?


The full back office: registered agent, EIN, US business banking setup, bookkeeping, compliance and annual reports, and tax filing.


#### Is doola available in other AI tools?


Yes. doola MCP is live across Claude, Replit, ChatGPT, Lovable, Perplexity and Vercel.
